content.short: Seaport is an open-source Web3 protocol by OpenSea for safe and efficient NFT trading.
content.description: Seaport is an open-source Web3 trading protocol that prioritizes safety and efficiency in transactions. It enables offers to include both cryptocurrencies and NFTs, supports partial fills, tipping, and advanced filtering, and minimizes redundant transfers to streamline execution. Built with Solidity Assembly language, Seaport offers a flexible order framework that helps participants optimize throughput and maintain clear, auditable workflows.
